They provide service patient education and a management system designed to integrate into the clinic's workflow.

about_short_description.short_description: 22otters is a mobile healthcare app to help patients.

product.name: Procedure Prep
product.description: A mobile app feature that guides patients through preparation tasks for GI and urology procedures with reminders and task tracking.

product.name: Stoma Care
product.description: A mobile guide for patients undergoing stoma procedures, offering preparation, post-procedure care, symptom monitoring, and reminders.

product.name: Discharge
product.description: A mobile tool that helps patients monitor symptoms and manage lifestyle changes to reduce heart and lung disease risks after hospital discharge.

product.name: MRSA Prevention
product.description: A mobile app feature that supports patients in following MRSA decolonization treatment with reminders and task tracking to reduce infection risk.

product.name: Lipid Panel
product.description: A mobile tool that helps patients understand cholesterol tests, assess heart failure risk, and manage follow-up care with reminders and explanations.

product.name: General Visits
product.description: A mobile app feature that enhances patient experience around clinic visits by managing medication lists, questions, directions, and appointment details.
